exposure: Different types of CP (spastic, dyskinetic, mixed, ataxic-hypotonic)
Different subtypes of CP (quadriparetic, diplegic, hemiparetic, monoparetic)
cohort: 169 patients with CP at the Pediatric Neurology Clinic of Cerrahpasa Medical School
finding: Asphyxia, low birth weight, and prematurity were the main risk factors for CP, and encephalomalacia was the most common imaging finding.
mod_finding: Delivery mode (vaginal vs. cesarean section) was recorded, but no specific findings related to mode of birth were reported.
followup_time: Mean age at diagnosis was 27.3 months
